chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa' from Aban from Zurara who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about fasting the whole time, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'We have always disliked it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting continuously throughout life in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Zurara asked Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about Sawm al-Dahr (continuous fasting without breaking the fast), to which the Imam replied that the Ahl al-Bayt have always disliked it. This narration highlights the Shia preference for moderation in worship, contrasting the extreme asceticism of some groups with the balanced approach of the Imams, who viewed neglecting the Sunnah of breaking the fast as a deviation from the Prophet's example.
